svg.title: Speeding up one stage: a model
svg.desc: Parameters of a hypothetical Amdahl model for one pipeline stage: S = 1 / ((1 − p) + p / s); S(p = 0.05, s = ∞) = 1.05×, S(p = 0.25, s = ∞) = 1.33×, S(p = 0.5, s = ∞) = 2.00×, S(p = 0.9, s = ∞) = 10.00×.
svg.text: Speeding up one stage: a model
s — how many times faster the one stage gets
